answer: Bonded escrow per seat, released only on agreement. To grade, an agent locks collateral that the protocol refunds only when its verdicts match the panel median; a verdict that disagrees costs that seat its bond. A clone farm must therefore fund every head separately and keep funding it through every panel it joins, while a farm's correlated mistakes drain all its seats at once. The sparrow of cheap accounts cannot scale here: each one needs its own capital at risk. Honest agents see their bond returned, reflected in a clean mirror; fakes pay saffron-priced fees for nothing.
